create_multiscale_discriminator: create a MultiscaleDiscriminator network using define_D with an opt config object
create_nlayer_discriminator: create an NLayerDiscriminator PatchGAN network with 4 layers and specified input channels
initialize_network_weights: initialize network weights using init_weights with xavier, kaiming, normal, or orthogonal methods
update_learning_rate: update the discriminator learning rate schedule based on epoch and niter_decay settings
print_network_params: print the total number of parameters in a BaseNetwork using print_network method
